mapper.select: select * from service_concern_and_record where name like concat('%',#{name},'%') and project_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')

SELECT sc.elderly_id AS elderlyId, sc.name AS name, sc.gender AS gender, sc.age AS age, sc.id_number AS idNumber, sc.nurse_name AS nurseName, sc.project_id AS projectId, sc.project_name AS projectName, sc.description AS description, sc.care_status AS careStatus, sc.price AS price, sc.nurse_level AS nurseLevel, sc.service_duration AS serviceDuration FROM service_concern_and_record sc WHERE elderly_id = #{elderlyId} and project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT sc.elderly_id AS elderlyId, sc.name AS name, sc.gender AS gender, sc.age AS age, sc.id_number AS idNumber, sc.nurse_name AS nurseName, sc.project_name AS projectName, sc.description AS description, sc.care_status AS careStatus, sc.price AS price, sc.service_duration AS serviceDuration FROM service_concern_and_record sc
WHERE sc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
